overview: Experienced in translating ambiguous business requirements into rigorous, testable system models and architectural blueprints. Specializing in Business Process Modeling (BPMN 2.0 AS-IS/TO-BE), UML behavioral & structural specifications (Sequence, Use Case, Activity), 3NF Relational Database Schema Design (ERD), and Clean Architecture component boundaries.

diagrams.description: Comprehensive business process modeling for BLT-DD social assistance distribution using Naive Bayes classification based on 8 socioeconomic criteria, automated posterior probability calculation, and village deliberation validation.

Operator Document Verification & System Input
Naive Bayes Prior & Conditional Probability Calculation
Exclusive Gateway (XOR) for Eligibility Ranking

diagrams.title: UML Use Case Diagram: DSS for Determining the Eligibility of Village Fund Direct Cash Assistance (BLT-DD) Recipients
diagrams.project: Decision Support System for BLT-DD Eligibility
diagrams.description: Functional scope and boundary specification for the Decision Support System (DSS) for determining the eligibility of Village Fund Direct Cash Assistance (BLT-DD) recipients, mapping user interactions for Administrators, and System Users.
key_elements: Multi-Criteria Eligibility Assessment (Vehicle Ownership, Housing Conditions, Income, Dependents, and Employment)
Beneficiary & Family Data Management (Household Records, Family Members, and Regional Information)
Naive Bayes Classification Model (Prior Probability, Likelihood, and Posterior Probability Calculation)
Training Dataset & Classification Data Management (Labeled Data, Testing Data, and Model Evaluation)
Automated Beneficiary Eligibility Prediction (Eligible and Not Eligible Classification)
Beneficiary Approval Workflow (Administrator and Village Head Authorization)
Classification Results, Reporting & Audit Trail (Eligibility Recapitulation and Decision History)
